Local frontend assets

The CDN URLs in the page templates have been replaced with Django static URLs.
Existing Font Awesome 4.7.0 CSS is reused, with its missing font files added.
Bootstrap 5.3.8 and unminified jQuery 3.7.1 match the general-page CDN files;
previous Habitus Bootstrap/jQuery files are intentionally unchanged.

The unpinned URLs resolved to Pickr 1.10.2, DaisyUI 5.7.47,
Tailwind browser 4.3.3 and Font Awesome kit CSS 7.3.1 at localization time.
Font Awesome's v4/v5 font-face and v4 class shims retain the kit configuration.
The kit loader itself is replaced by local CSS; no kit/network loader remains.

Google fonts are in assets/site/vendor/google-fonts. The two original Google
CSS requests retain all declared families, weights, styles, unicode subsets
and font-display: swap. Shared binary URLs are stored once, even where several
weights reference them. 54 files are unicode-subset binaries, not 54 added
styles. No new font families or weights were requested.

localized-assets.json records upstream sources and SHA-256 checksums.
Licenses are retained alongside the libraries/fonts. CSS font URLs and two
jsDelivr source-map comments are the only modifications to downloaded assets.
Bootstrap and jQuery SRI attributes remain valid against the local bytes.

Deployment: use the normal Django collectstatic workflow. Validation collected
into a disposable STATIC_ROOT; tracked root static/ was not edited manually.
Browser QA used a temporary database and a test-only Content-Security-Policy
blocking non-local CSS, JS, fonts, images and connections. The site settings
and production CSP were not changed.
